title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you add more features to a model, think about how it affects the model's complexity. More features can make the model more flexible, but what does that mean for bias and variance?

title: Training vs. Testing Error
text: Consider why the training error might decrease when you add more features. What does this tell you about the model's ability to fit the training data? Now, think about why the testing error might increase.
